utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Placentia' by name among the cities in its service area.

generation_supplier.notes: Orange County Power Authority (OCPA), the CCA operating in Orange County, currently names Buena Park, Fullerton, and Irvine as members (with Fountain Valley reported joining in 2027) — Placentia was not named among current or announced members this session. Left null rather than asserted either way.

county.notes: Placentia is a well-documented Orange County city; also listed under Orange County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of Placentia Development Services Department, Building Division

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Placentia/Orange County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: Two sets of structural calculations, wet stamped and wet signed by a licensed California Engineer

Two sets of plans, wet stamped and wet signed by a licensed California Engineer or Architect, showing property lines, roof direction/pitch, north arrow, collector location, installation methods, and construction details
Proof solar collectors are tested and approved by IAPMO, the City of Los Angeles Solar Collecting Testing Laboratory, or an agency approved by the Chief Building Official
Manufacturer specifications with efficiency data and certification proof
Photographs showing the proposed location's visibility from neighboring properties and streets
Valid government ID, state contractor ID, and business license (for permit issuance)

value: Call (714) 993-8124 for inspection requests during business hours (7:30am-6:00pm, Monday-Thursday)
The City does not schedule same-day inspections

value.program_or_pathway: Standard plan-check submittal (planning/zoning clearance required first)
other_conditions: Must comply with the latest adopted Uniform Building and Uniform Solar Energy Codes

eligibility_constraints.notes: No evidence of a SolarAPP+ or other automated/expedited pathway was found for Placentia this session — the process described is standard plan-check review.
